answer: Treat cash-out paths as identity. When rewards from several accounts flow into the same downstream wallet within a few epochs, the ledger merges them into one cluster that shares a single pay cap and loses the excess from locked balance. A farm of fifty keys then earns like one unless it keeps fifty exit routes that never touch, each costing fees and time. The rule is public and hard as quartz: no whisper campaign or fable about coincidence moves it, only an on-chain path showing the funds really parted ways.
